title: Build a reviewer evaluation set from escaped defects
body:
Collect defects that passed review and were found later (claim race B1, forward dropping task B2, GitHub check-run shape, overrides of #112/#114/#463) as replayable cases, and score the review panel against them on every change to its prompt, model or tools.
Acceptance: the set replays through krn review and reports recall and false-positive rate; a reviewer change records its score.
